description: This file defines the AxisMapper class responsible for mapping properties from a DocumentObjectModel Axis object to a rendering Axis object within the MigraDoc chart rendering system. It contains methods to translate chart axis configurations such as tick labels, gridlines, title, scale, and line formats.

classes.name: AxisMapper
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping chart axis properties from a document object model to rendering objects.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps properties from a DocumentObjectModel Shapes.Charts.Axis object to an Axis object used in rendering.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method that creates an instance of AxisMapper and calls MapObject to perform the mapping.
